create_optimization_trace: create an OptimizationTrace report section with objective values, candidate parameters, and optional bounds for visualization
build_objective_plot: build a Plotly figure showing the objective function value over optimization iterations
build_candidate_plots: build paged Plotly figures displaying candidate parameter values and their changes across iterations
build_candidate_heatmap: build a Plotly heatmap figure showing normalized candidate parameter values across iterations
get_report_context: get the report context dictionary containing HTML strings for objective plot, candidate plots, and heatmap
